text:
ajay: Heads-up: starting bring-up for qx6b-int6 candidate for conv+codegen benchmarks. Need a quick curation + smoke labeling pass on a 2k prompt sample. Want to catch regressions vs qx4b and q6b baseline. planning to run tok-len stratified sample + edgecase spike.

marie: I can generate the stratified sample. do you want equal buckets by token-length or weighted by traffic? :thinking:

ajay: weighted by recent traffic makes sense (70% short/medium, 20% long, 10% very-long). include 150 synthetic code completions and 200 conversational multi-turn threads.

lisa: label_ops - we'll need an expedited golden pass on ~200 items flagged as high-risk (long code + sensitive). can we tag them with priority:qbringup so labelers pick them first? @label_ops

label_ops: yep, we can create priority:qbringup. ETA for 2k with 2x labelers is ~18 hours if we keep batch size 25. we can do an initial 200 golden samples in ~3 hours.

dmitri: also add quant-smoke logs to the thread. watch for tokenization drift and kvcache glitches. I've seen int6 kernels mis-handle padded seqs in one micro-batch pattern. sample run command below:
```
# sample generation for smoke
rbatch sample \
  --model qx6b-int6 \
  --n 2000 \
  --strata "short:0.45,medium:0.25,long:0.2,very-long:0.1" \
  --seed 42 \
  --out /tmp/qx6b-smoke.json
```

marie: great. i'll push the sample to /datasets/curation/qx6b-smoke and add a CSV with simple heuristics for edge detection (html, sql, code fences, urls). i'll also attach a tiny prompt-augmentation script to surface prefix truncation cases.

sam: checklist request: 1) sample exported 2) quick dedupe pass 3) 200 golden annotated 4) run automated evals (perplexity, token-overlap) 5) manual compare vs qx4b/q6b 6) report. correct?

ajay: yes, add 7) rollback plan if major regressions (>5% user-impact metric) and 8) fallback route to q6b-hosted for production traffic.

lisa: for dedupe, use fuzzyhash threshold 0.86 then exact fingerprint. i've seen int6 bringups fail when near-duplicates sneak into golden. i'll drop a dedupe command:
```
python tools/dedupe.py --input /tmp/qx6b-smoke.json --out /tmp/qx6b-smoke-dedup.json --fuzzy 0.86
```

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/qx6b-int6-smoke #112 by ajay. Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/112 :robot_face:

dmitri: when you run the evals, add an answer-sanity script that checks for truncated code blocks and malformed JSON outputs. those are the most common int6 regressions.

marie: done. i'll seed the labeler queue with priority:qbringup and upload the deduped set by EOD. will tag high-risk samples in the CSV with labeler notes.

label_ops: received. starting golden on the 200 high-risk set now. will ping when first 50 are done for quick triage. :thumbsup:

sam: can someone paste the metric comparison stub? i want to reuse it for future bringups.

ajay: i'll post it after the smoke run. basic columns: sample_id, prompt_len, baseline_q6b_score, qx4b_score, qx6b_score, regression_flag, severity, notes.

lisa: small but important: remember to lock model alias mapping in rollout config so traffic can be pinned during A/B. i had a support ticket earlier where alias flip caused a noisy spike.

ajay: good call. i'll open a canary rollout with 1% traffic to qx6b-int6 and keep auto-fallback to q6b-hosted. planning smoke run in ~30m. will update thread with artifacts and final summary. :fire:
